families.description: Cat head, ginger-striped ears, green eyes, pink-brown nose, and white muzzle
Cat ginger back, shoulder stripes, and white chest ruff
Dark charcoal-brown curly hair mass framing the man's upper head and temple
Man's eyebrows, eyes with dark iris rims and sclera lights, and nose bridge/tip
Man's cheeks, moustache/beard stubble, and mouth shadow
Unpainted bright watercolor paper ground surrounding the portrait pair

reserves.reason: Crisp specular catchlight on the viewer-right side of the cat's right iris
Bright iris highlight inside the cat's viewer-left eye
Bright white whisker-pad highlight below the cat's nose
Reserved paper-white fur on the cat's chest ruff
Sclera highlight on the outer corner of the man's viewer-left eye
Lit upper-eyelid and brow-bone plane above the man's viewer-left eye
Inner sclera highlight of the man's viewer-right eye
Paper-white highlight along the bridge of the man's nose
Lit cheekbone highlight to viewer-left of the man's nose
Open unpainted paper between the cat's ears and the top of the man's head

styleSelection.reason: Watercolor portrait sketch with fine sepia ink lines, light transparent washes, and over half the sheet held as bare paper

cat-head-ears.reason: Crisp eye rims, ear contours, and warm ginger tabby stripes over reserved white fur

cat-body-chest.reason: Light warm orange-sienna washes grading softly into the white chest ruff

man-curly-hair.reason: Layered cool-charcoal washes and energetic curl accents with interstitial paper gaps

man-eyes-brow-nose.reason: Fine pen definition on eyelids, irises, and nostrils with delicate warm skin washes

man-beard-lower-face.reason: Light warm skin wash with broken stubble texture and subtle lip/beard shadow

open-paper-ground.reason: Clean bare cold-press watercolor paper around the portrait silhouette
